overview_description.description:
Marathon Education has provided ed-tech software that is designed to change the after-school tutoring market.

The company's platform uses analytics and technology to pinpoint students' weak areas and suggest the appropriate lessons. It is also building a platform for instructors to connect with students around the nation, focusing on academics and allowing students to concentrate on their studies online.

Marathon Education was established in 2021 by Tung Tran and Duc Pham in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

product.name: Live Online Tutoring
product.description: A live, interactive online tutoring service for K-12 students, providing real-time lessons with specialized teachers.

product.name: Personalized Learning Pathways
product.description: Customized study plans tailored to individual student needs to guide their learning progress and outcomes.

product.name: Study Support Materials
product.description: A repository of educational resources and practice materials for various subjects and grade levels.

product.name: Academic Advising Support
product.description: Ongoing academic support from advisors to assist students in understanding lessons and resolving doubts.

product.name: One-on-One Tutoring Sessions
product.description: Flexible, individualized tutoring sessions scheduled between a student and a teacher for personalized instruction.

product.name: Exam Preparation Courses
product.description: Courses designed to prepare students for entrance exams and standardized tests through focused review and practice.
